text:
Use **Rust** if you need maximum performance and control, or are working on systems/embedded code.

Use **Go** if you need fast development, concurrency, or microservices.

Quick comparison:

| Rust | Go |
|------|----|
| Compiled, no GC | Compiled, GC |
| Steeper learning curve | Easier to learn |
| Memory safety without pointers | Simpler concurrency |
| Better performance | Good enough performance |

Pick based on your goals:
- Systems, embedded, performance-critical → Rust
- Web services, APIs, quick prototyping → Go

Both are excellent. Pick the one matching your project needs.
